title: Demons Sharing Crystals
description: A blue horned demon kneels on the left while a larger red horned demon kneels on the right, both holding and exchanging glowing yellow crystals and flowers in a dark fantasy setting. They are surrounded by green grass, purple mist, and a background of cracked blue stone walls with hanging red handprints.
